Dear [Miss Hutchins](../persons.html#739)
I am so sorry I did not send these before.

They came at a very busy time, and I am sorry to say I put them into a drawer with some Christmas cards and forgot them till [Miss Cazenove](../persons.html#274) reminded me.

Yours truly

C M Yonge
